_comment: Team catalog. Schema per VIDEO-GENERATION-PLAN.md §5.4. Team identity is expressed ONLY through solid colour palettes, associated players and contextual venues — never official logos, crests or readable text. jersey_description must always end with 'no logos, no numbers, no lettering'.
